image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) surrounded by a textured, leathery girdle. The background consists of coarse sand, small pebbles, and reddish algae/seaweed.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A thick, textured band of tissue (the girdle) surrounds the plates, appearing leathery and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature. The animal is currently extended and adhering, not curled.
